neighbours.label: the word-piece 'ee' right after 'st' in a split word (st|ee|ple, st|ee|pest); the whole token ' steep' does not fire
fire: From the harbour you can make out the white steeple of the parish church.
Lightning struck the steeple twice during the storm last August.
Housing costs rose steepest in the cities along the coast.
The bell in the steeple has not been rung since the fire.
We took the steepest route down because it was also the shortest.
A weathervane sits on top of the steeple above the clock.
The decline in sales was steepest among the smaller shops.
Workers put scaffolding around the steeple to repair the slate roof.
quiet: From the harbour you can make out the white tower of the parish church.
Lightning struck the chimney twice during the storm last August.
Housing costs rose fastest in the cities along the coast.
The path was steep and the stones were slippery after the rain.
We took the shortest route down because the street was closed.
A weathervane sits on top of the barn above the green door.
The employee said the fee was too high for such a small tree.
Workers put scaffolding around the spire to repair the slate roof.
